_about: Template for the door's local config.json (mode 0600). Never commit the filled file: it says where R's keyring and its passphrase live. install.sh copies this template; the household fills every <...>. chain_version is the version the door was measured on (zerone-1, 2026-10-28, h1,402,985); change it only after re-measuring gas on a new version.

zeroned.path: <absolute path of the pinned zeroned that install.sh copied>

registrar.key_name: <R's key name inside its file keyring>
registrar.keychain_service: <login-Keychain generic-password service that holds the keyring passphrase>
